description: Image Description: The image depicts a natural savanna landscape under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground, there is a wide expanse of dry, sandy ground with sparse patches of green grass and small shrubs scattered across it. The terrain appears arid, with visible soil and minimal vegetation. In the midground, two elephants are walking side by side from left to right across the open area. They are dark gray in color, with large ears and long trunks, characteristic of African elephants.
